command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 1; adb shell input tap 540 2200; sleep 1; adb exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers.png; sips -Z 480 -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 55 /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers.png --out /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers.jpg >/dev/null; base64 < /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers.jpg | tr -d '\n' > /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers.jpg.b64; split -b 1800 -a 2 /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers.jpg.b64 /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers-; echo THERMOMETERS_CAPTURED; adb shell input tap 900 2200; sleep 1; adb exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings.png; sips -Z 480 -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 55 /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings.png --out /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings.jpg >/dev/null; base64 < /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings.jpg | tr -d '\n' > /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings.jpg.b64; split -b 1800 -a 2 /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings.jpg.b64 /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings-; echo SETTINGS_CAPTURED; wc -c /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/thermometers-* /tmp/lcl-ux-v142/settings-*; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
